prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover end, and a dented rear door skin with a broken side marker lens. The pattern of contact is largely consistent with a sideswipe at lane-change speed. Parts and paint materials on the estimate appear in order, and no duplicate line items were found. Labor hours run slightly above typical for this extent of damage, so a review of blend and refinish time is recommended. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file. Proceed with repair as scoped once the labor adjustment is confirmed.
